oracle-l5r-9267: The Waystation of the Path (Phoenix Temple Stronghold): "Reaction: After another player's action targets your performing Henshin, target another of your Personalities. The Henshin is reborn. Transfer his attachments and tokens to the other Personality. The action's effects that would destroy your Henshin instead overlay him onto the Personality." Three pieces are missing. (1) "Reborn" is not defined anywhere in docs/rules/EMPEROR_EDITION_CORE_RULES.md (Henshin is named only as a keyword, and no rule says what being reborn does to the Henshin card: whether he leaves play, goes to a deck or hand, or simply becomes the other Personality) and no wired card uses it, so wiring it would invent a rule. (2) "Overlay him onto the Personality" reuses the Experienced overlay (an Experienced card placed over a base Personality of the same title), but here the overlaid card is a Henshin over an arbitrary, differently-titled Personality; the engine's overlay command and its same-title/experience-level checks (Experienced.cs) cannot express that. (3) "The action's effects that would destroy your Henshin instead" is a substitution of a destruction effect by another effect on the SAME action (before the destruction resolves, keyed to the Henshin as target); the engine has destruction negation and delay (NegatesEffect, DelayedDestruction) but no replacement effect. It would also need the target-of-action reaction to be offered to the target's controller when the Henshin is the PERFORMER of an action the other player targets him with (a 'your performing Henshin' condition on the reactor, which no targeted-by-action reaction reads today). To build: Mendon to define 'reborn' and the Henshin-over-Personality overlay; then add a targeted-by-action Reaction with a replacement of the held action's destroy effect by an overlay, plus the attachment/token transfer (AttachmentTransfers.cs already moves attachments between Personalities).
